item.title: Apple CEO Tim Cook Asked About Retirement Again, Here's What He Said
item.description: In an all-hands meeting with employees on Thursday, Apple CEO Tim Cook briefly touched on the topic of retirement, but he remained coy about his plans. item.title: NASA Now Allowing Astronauts to Bring Their iPhones on Space Missions
item.description: NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman on Wednesday announced that NASA astronauts will soon be permitted to fly with "the latest smartphones," beginning with the SpaceX Crew-12 and Artemis II missions over the next few months. In an email, an Apple spokesperson said this will mark the first time the iPhone has been fully qualified for extended use in orbit and beyond. item.title: Why Apple's iOS 26.4 Siri Upgrade Will Be Bigger Than Originally Promised
item.description: In the iOS 26.4 update that's coming this spring, Apple will introduce a new version of Siri that's going to overhaul how we interact with the personal assistant and what it's able to do.
